answer: First, the applicant stores a 10 GB shard and publishes its Merkle root; the registry rejects incomplete roots. Second, verifiers issue 3 chunk challenges daily for 30 days, requiring 90 proofs; a miss in 24 hours suspends the haven account until it re-proves. Third, auditors split the shard like a prism, checking separate chunks so one fake cannot pass every angle. Faking 100 identities needs 1,000 GB at $0.02 per GB-month, or $20 monthly plus 9,000 proofs; one honest month earns a velvet trading path. Like a warehouse opened after counting its shelves, entry follows proof.
